CalibrationSourceEnum.description: Provenance class of a device-record value: how much trust the value carries and why. Refusal is a first-class outcome, distinct from absence.
CalibrationSourceEnum.title: CalibrationSourceEnum

Device.description: One recording device in the dataset. Shipped as `devices.csv` at the dataset root, one row per device: identity, display geometry, calibration with provenance, and capabilities. Referenced by `StudyflowLog.device_id` in the trial family.

camera_present.description: Whether a camera was available to the session.
camera_present.title: Camera Present

device_id.description: A unique identifier assigned to the device, used to link runs (`StudyflowLog.device_id`) to the device that recorded them.
device_id.title: Device Id

device_pixel_ratio.description: Ratio of device pixels to OS-scaled logical pixels (e.g., 2.0 on a Retina display).
device_pixel_ratio.title: Device Pixel Ratio

dpi_raw.description: The raw pixel-density value the platform reported, before any plausibility gating — kept for audit, since platform values are wrong in known ways (e.g., Windows reports the user's scaling setting, not panel density).
dpi_raw.title: Dpi Raw

input_devices.description: Input devices available to the session (e.g., `mouse`, `trackpad`, `keyboard`, `touchscreen`, `eyetracker`). Individual devices producing data streams are identified per stream by `source` (see the vocabulary term).
input_devices.title: Input Devices

microphone_present.description: Whether a microphone was available to the session.
microphone_present.title: Microphone Present

os_version.description: Version of the operating system, free-form.
os_version.title: Os Version

pixel_aspect_verified.description: Whether pixel squareness was verified (e.g., by asking which of several ellipses looks round). A horizontal-only calibration assumes square pixels.
pixel_aspect_verified.title: Pixel Aspect Verified

px_per_cm.description: Pixel density of the display: device pixels per centimetre, as calibrated or derived. The bridge from pixel geometry to physical size.
px_per_cm.title: Px Per Cm

px_per_cm_measured_at.description: When the `px_per_cm` value was measured or derived.
px_per_cm_measured_at.title: Px Per Cm Measured At

screen_count.description: Number of displays attached to the device during the study.
screen_count.title: Screen Count

screen_refresh_rate.description: Refresh rate of the display, in hertz.
screen_refresh_rate.title: Screen Refresh Rate

screen_resolution.description: Resolution of the display as [width, height], in device pixels (the native raster).
screen_resolution.title: Screen Resolution

screen_size_cm.description: Physical size of the display as [width, height], in centimetres. BIDS `ScreenSize` uses metres; divide by 100 to map.
screen_size_cm.title: Screen Size Cm

touch_capable.description: Whether the display accepts touch input.
touch_capable.title: Touch Capable

DevicesData.description: Root container mapping the Device table to an array of its rows.
DevicesData.title: DevicesData
